2115024599486497259.en_summary: $NVDA is expanding its $META partnership beyond GPUs into standalone Vera CPUs and security software for AI agents. As AI shifts toward agents, Nvidia targets CPU spending traditionally held by $INTC and $AMD, adding another software lock-in layer beyond CUDA.

ticker_notes.NVDA: 擴展至 CPU 和安全軟體，搶佔 CPU 市場並加強軟體鎖定

2115016452516270335.en_summary: U.S. stocks edged higher pre-market shrugging off massive AI equity issuances including Anthropic’s likely $100B IPO, OpenAI’s expected offering and META’s $100B secondary. Markets await Fed’s likely hawkish hold tomorrow and earnings from $GOOG, $MSFT and $AMZN. Brent rose to $117, 10-year yield eased to 4.98%, BTC held at $79.7K. Tech higher and $TSLA rose amid $SPCX merger speculation. S&P 2026 EPS estimates of $369 (+33% YoY) imply 4.8% earnings yield inverted versus Treasuries. Cautious on $TSLA given extreme valuation (2026 P/E of 220x vs +45% long-term earnings growth), negative forward earnings revisions and commoditization of autonomous driving technology.
2115016452516270335.zh_summary: 美股盤前小幅上漲，投資者忽略大規模 AI 股權發行，包括 Anthropic 可能的 1000 億美元 IPO、OpenAI 預期發行以及 META 的 1000 億美元二次發行。市場等待明日聯儲局可能的鷹派維持利率決定以及本週 $GOOG、$MSFT 和 $AMZN 的業績。布倫特油價升至 117 美元，10 年期國債收益率回落至 4.98%，BTC 維持在 7.97 萬美元。科技股普遍上漲，$TSLA 因 $SPCX 合併傳聞上漲。標普 2026 年 EPS 估計為 369 美元（同比 +33%）意味著 4.8% 盈利收益率，相對國債倒掛如 1990 年代末。對 $TSLA 保持謹慎，因其極端估值（2026 年市盈率 220 倍對比長期盈利增長 +45%）、前瞻盈利下修以及自動駕駛技術商品化。

ticker_notes.TSLA: 極端估值 2026 P/E 220x 對比長期增長 +45%，前瞻盈利下修及自動駕駛商品化

ticker_notes.ACI: CEO 稱經濟艱難、通脹高企，客流和銷量不足，對業務軌跡不滿意
